exposure: Presence of microbes in other sites (maternal cervix, neonatal gastric, bronchial)
cohort: The study included a prospective cohort of 73 mothers and 87 neonates, and a retrospective cohort of 991 mothers and 1,121 neonates.
finding: Preterm neonates exhibited decreased oral microbiome diversity with fewer beneficial bacteria and more pathogens, and the neonatal gastric culture was most similar to the maternal cervical culture, indicating mother-to-newborn transmission.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was identified as a factor influencing neonatal oral microbiome diversity.
gest_age: Preterm neonates were a specific group analyzed for oral microbiome diversity.
